title: Twelve-piece band at Lincoln Garden with Marie Lucas
summary: Burton expands his nine-piece band into a twelve-piece at Lincoln Garden, sharing piano with Marie Lucas.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: some people didn't know that I once went in for the large band that I was telling about when I had a small band at that time at that time we had a nine piece band we got a booking for the state and congress bearless wheel the con instrument people like the outfit and they want to book us over to country and give us all the con instruments the appetites for them and this Jones fellow that was the announcer and master ceremony of Lincoln Garden he talked me in to coming into Lincoln Garden on this job adding these other pieces which made it a twelve piece band the woman that was in there was a great pianist a great trombone player named Marie Lucas from New York and Geraldine was a great violin player and another little young boy just out of high school can't think if his name now was playing violin so that's where the twelve pieces come in Jones they was friend of Jones so was this piano player friend of mine I played with her and traveled on the show with her named Marie Lucas and they said if you just set your piano player side and take this job with Marie Lucas on the piano and she ranges too and this blah blah I said well I said I am not the fellow that runs out on my people they all think the world of me and they sticking with me and I got a nice nine piece outfit and I got the greatest woman piano player in Chicago and I says Marie Lucas and I is good close friends from years in the past

said if we can get together where we can use two piano players I says I'll accept the proposition I says the bigger place as Lincoln Garden is and Uncle Billy King has got a big floor show here I said you need two piano players to keep the music going I said you see now here will be the way to arrange it my piano player has never had no experience playing no show that's out she's got to have that training Marie Lucas knows the show she can arrange and write she can direct she can play trombone I keep the people entertained I says when the intermission time comes you know what I'll do I'll get up to the piano and come into the playing
